admissible_command_formatting: one per line, prefixed '- ', verbatim from info['admissible_commands'][0], in engine order
history_serialization: identical to Config A: intro, then '> {action}\n{observation}' per step
inventory: EnvInfos.inventory is None on ALFWorld games; nothing injected. The agent may issue the 'inventory' action itself.

parser.on_invalid: issue the normalised string verbatim; TextWorld answers 'Nothing happens.'

icl_examples.selection_rule: train split, sorted, Random(13).shuffle, first pick_and_place_simple solved by upstream HandCodedTWAgent within 25 steps

only_change: backbone (+ the chat_template_kwargs needed for Qwen3 non-thinking mode)

backbone.note: Qwen3-32B is a hybrid-reasoning model; there is no separate '-Instruct-AWQ' release. Non-thinking / direct-answer mode is selected via chat_template_kwargs.enable_thinking=false.
backbone.quantization: AWQ 4-bit, group_size 128, gemm; vLLM runtime kernel awq_marlin
backbone.architecture: Qwen3ForCausalLM, 64 layers, 64 heads, 8 KV heads, head_dim 128
backbone.device: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5090 (32607 MiB), driver 595.71.05, CUDA 13.2
